{{redirect|Life Leech|the support gem|Life Leech Support|the passive skill|Life Leech (passive skill)}} {{redirect|Mana Leech|the support gem|Mana Leech Support}} '''Leech''' [[Recovery|recovers]] an amount of [[life]], [[mana]], or [[energy shield]] over time, relative to the [[damage]] inflicted on an enemy. Leech is based on the damage taken by the enemy, not the amount of life removed. ==Mechanics== {| class="wikitable" style="float:right; margin-left: 10px;" |+ Default Leech limitations between different resources. |- ! Resource ! {{tooltip| Leech Cap| % of maximum Resource Leeched per instance}} ! {{tooltip| LPS| % of maximum Resource leeched per second per instance}} ! {{tooltip| Total LPS| Total % of maximum Resource leeched per second}} |- | [[Life]] || {{#vardefine: life_leech_max_% | 10}} {{#var: life_leech_max_%}}% || {{#vardefine: life_leech_rate_% | 2}} {{#var: life_leech_rate_%}}% || {{#vardefine: life_leech_rate_max_%| 20}} {{#var: life_leech_rate_max_%}}% |- | [[Energy Shield]] || {{#vardefine: es_leech_max_% | 10}} {{#var: es_leech_max_%}}% || {{#vardefine: es_leech_rate_% | 2}} {{#var: es_leech_rate_%}}% || {{#vardefine: es_leech_rate_max_%| 10}} {{#var: es_leech_rate_max_%}}% |- | [[Mana]] || {{#vardefine: mana_leech_max_% | 10}} {{#var: mana_leech_max_%}}% || {{#vardefine: mana_leech_rate_% | 2}} {{#var: mana_leech_rate_%}}% || {{#vardefine: mana_leech_rate_max_%| 20}} {{#var: mana_leech_rate_max_%}}% |} {{#vardefine: leech_max_%| {{#var: life_leech_max_%}} }} {{#vardefine: leech_rate_%| {{#var: life_leech_rate_%}} }} {{#vardefine: leech_rate_max_%| {{#var: life_leech_rate_max_%}} }} All leech mechanics act the same way for life, mana, and energy shield. Examples in this article use life, but if the character has equal statistics for a different resource (mana or energy shield), they will apply in the same way. Whenever a character with some source of leech [[hit]]s a monster, a leech instance is created. Hitting multiple enemies with a single use of a skill creates that many leech instances. Life Leech instances have the following properties by default: * Each instance is independent. * Multiple leech instances stack and apply simultaneously. * There is no limit to the possible number of active leech instances * Each instance Recovers the character's life for the Damage Dealt * {{c|mod|% damage Leeched as Life}} up to a maximum of {{#var: leech_max_%}}% of maximum life. * Each instance Recovers at a rate of {{#var: leech_rate_%}}% of maximum life per second. * Each instance Recovers until the total amount of leeched damage was recovered or the character reaches full unreserved life. * The total recovery rate of all life leech instances is limited to {{#var: leech_rate_max_%}}% of maximum life or mana per second (10% for energy shield). The extra recovery over that cap will be ignored. Leech grants recovery to the entity that hits the target. If a [[minion]] or [[totem]] with leech hits an enemy, leech will grant recovery to that minion or totem, not the character. Skills used by totems and other [[proxies]] create leech instances with recovery caps based on the player's maximum life, not their own.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rbWlkdBfjtU While recovery is irrelevant for most proxies because they're immortal, untargetable, or have 1 life, it may be relevant for uniques like {{il|Machina Mitts}} or {{il|The Retch}}. ===Modifiers=== Leech can be modified significantly through passives, support gems, and equipment. Modifiers affecting life leech are {{c|mod|damage Leeched as Life}}, {{C|mod|Maximum Recovery per Life Leech}}, {{C|mod|total Recovery per second from Life Leech}} and {{C|mod|Maximum total Life Recovery per second from Leech}}. * Additional {{c|mod|damage Leeched as Life}} reduces the amount of damage required to reach the maximum possible amount of life that can be recovered by a single instance. * {{C|mod|50% increased Maximum Recovery per Life Leech}} increases the default {{#var: leech_max_%}}% of the maximum life that can be leeched by an instance to {{#expr: {{#var: leech_max_%}} * (1 + 0.5) }}%. * {{C|mod|50% increased Maximum total Life Recovery per second from Leech}} increases the default {{#var: leech_rate_max_%}}% of maximum life that can be recovered per second from all instances combined to {{#expr: {{#var: leech_rate_max_%}} * (1 + 0.5) }}%. * {{C|mod|#% increased total Recovery per second from Life Leech}} increases the player's recovery from leech, allowing the cap to be reached with fewer hits. It does not modify individual leech instances (and correspondingly has no effect on leech duration). There are a few notable ways to affect leech: * A [[skill]] supported by the {{il|Life Leech}}, {{il|Mana Leech}}, or {{il|Energy Leech Support}} grants leech of their respective types. * {{psl|Bone Barrier}}, {{il|The Baron}}, {{il|Machina Mitts}}, [[Totem Mastery]] and {{il|Trolltimber Spire}} allow other entities to leech life for you. * {{psl|Brutal Fervour}}, {{psl|q_where=passive_skills.name="Slayer" AND ascendancy_class="Ascendant"}}, {{psl|Immortal Ambition}}, {{il|Offering to the Serpent}}, {{psl|Soul Drinker}} and {{il|Essentia Sanguis}} allow leech instances to continue even if the character's unreserved life (or energy shield) is filled. {{sl|Petrified Blood}} achieves a similar effect by preventing recovery above [[low life]]. * Players can prevent enemies from leeching life from them by equipping {{il|Sin Trek}} or allocating [[Bloodless]]. ===Leech duration=== The duration of a life leech instance is defined by the maximum recovery per life leech, divided by the leech rate of {{#var: leech_rate_%}}% of maximum life per second. By default, the maximum amount of life leeched per instance is {{#var: leech_max_%}}% of a character's maximum Life, resulting in a maximum duration of {{#expr: {{#var: leech_max_%}} / {{#var: leech_rate_%}} }} seconds. No stat currently exists to modify the base rate of a leech instance. The maximum recovery may be modified through {{C|mod|Maximum Recovery per Life Leech}}, which in turn modifies maximum duration. For example, a 100% increase from [[Brutal Fervour]] will result in a maximum recovery per life leech of 20%, recovered at a rate of 2% per second for 10 seconds. Partial instant leech will reduce the total over time recovery, not the rate. For example, when 10% of leech is instant, and the leech instance recovers 1% instantly and 9% over time, its duration will be 4.5 seconds. Modifiers to {{C|mod|total Recovery per second from Life Leech}} amplify recovery from leech, not the base rate of the leech instance. Multiplying recovery does not 'empty' a leech instance faster. Additionally all instances of life leech are discarded as soon as the character reaches full unreserved life. This discarding can be prevented by overleech mechanics, for example by "Life Leech effects are not removed when Unreserved Life is Filled" effects like [[Immortal Ambition]] or [[Offering to the Serpent (Synthesised)]]. [[Petrified Blood]] also enable overleech as it ignores leech above low life without removing it. The leech duration is not modified by those effects, they just prevent premature end of the leech. Examples:
1. A character with none of the leech modifiers changed has 1.000 maximum life, with 1% of damage leeched, and hits 1 enemy 1 time for 4.000 damage. The leech is 40. It leeches 20 life per second for 2 seconds leeching a total of 40 life.
2. A character with none of the leech modifiers changed has 1.000 maximum life, with 1% of damage leeched, and hits 1 enemy 1 time for 40.000 damage. The leech is 400, reduced to the maximum of 100 total per life leech (instance). The character recovers 20 life per second for 5 seconds leeching a total of 100 life.
3. A character with none of the leech modifiers changed has 1.000 maximum life, with 1% of damage leeched, and hits 5 enemies 5 times each for 40.000 damage. The leech of each instance is 400, reduced to the maximum of 100 total per life leech (instance), with 25 leech instances. The character wants to recovers 2500 life per second, but is limited to 200 life per second from the Maximum Total Life Recovery Per Second from Leech. Each instance has a duration of 5 seconds, because it reached the Maximum Recovery per Life Leech. Each individual leech instance ends 5 seconds after the initial hit. The total recovered health depends on the time spread of the hits, due to all maximums being reached. ===Combined Recovery Rate=== The total life leech recovery rate is the sum of all recovery rates from all life leech instances. This combined rate is subject to the total leech rate cap, which is by default {{#var: leech_rate_max_%}}% of the character's maximum health. Reaching this maximum rate requires a number of leech instances equal the total maximum rate cap divided by the leech rate of each instance. For a default character, this is {{#expr: ({{#var: leech_rate_max_%}}/100 * (1 + 0)) / ({{#var: leech_rate_%}}/100 * (1 + 0)) }} instances, provided that each hit deals enough damage to reach the maximum amount that can be leeched per instance. ===Instant leech=== Effects that cause some or all of leech to be instant will still be capped by maximum recovery per leech. For partial instant leech, the duration of non-instant leech will be equal relative to its remain duration after instant leech. For example, using life leech with the {{c|mod|10% of Leech is Instant}} mod and no other modifiers to maximum leech, a single hit that leeches life for the maximum amount will recover 1% of your life instantly and the remaining 9% over 90% of the leech duration (4.5 seconds by default). Instant leech is not affected by modifiers to (leech) recovery rate, since its rate is instant. ==Types of leech== Several types of leech apply exclusively to certain [[skill]] types. Some leech types only work for [[attacks]], others only works with [[elemental damage]] or all sources of [[physical damage]]. Any such specializations are defined in the [[modifier]]. Generally the leech modifiers follow this template: {{c|mod|#% of X Y Damage Z Leeched as Life/Mana}} Where {{c|mod|X}} can be: * {{c|mod|Physical/Fire/Cold/Lightning/Elemental/Chaos}} {{c|mod|Y}} can be: * {{c|mod|Attack/Spell}} and {{c|mod|Z}} can be: * {{c|mod|Dealt with {[[Weapon]]s} }} Note that if {{c|mod|X}}, {{c|mod|Y}} or {{c|mod|Z}} are not specified it means that it applies to all those types. A couple of examples: * {{il|Life Leech}} has the mod {{c|mod|#% of Damage Leeched as Life}} implying it works for ''all'' types of skills that [[hit]] a target. * {{il|Warlord's Mark}} has the mod {{c|mod|Cursed enemies grant #% Life Leech when Hit by Attacks}}, specifying it applies to attacks. All types of damage from the attack will be counted, but not [[Spells]]. * The notable passive [[Lust for Carnage]] grants the mod {{c|mod|#% of Physical Attack Damage Leeched as Life}} specifying it applies to Physical Attacks. All types of weapons can make use of this notable, however not [[Spells]]. ==Items== ===Skill gems=== {{main|List of leech related skill gems}} {{#lst:List of leech related skill Shield%" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ===Mastery Effects=== {{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Leech%"}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.26.0| * Life and Mana Leech Modifiers on Equipment Items and Jewels now roll as Suffixes instead of Prefixes. This does not affect items with existing Prefix Leech Modifiers. * Physical Attack Damage Leeched as Life Modifiers on Weapons now scale from 2% to 4.5% (from 0.2-1.2). The level life leech modifiers appear on weapons has been lowered from level 50 to level 20. * The Physical Attack Damage Leeched as Mana Modifier on Weapons is now 2.6% to 3.2% (from 0.2-0.4%) * Physical Attack Damage Leeched as Life/Mana Essence Modifiers and Crafting Bench Modifiers on Weapons have been adjusted accordingly. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Added a cap on the amount of any resource you can leech from any individual instance of leech. By default, that cap is 10% of that resource's maximum. In other words, a character with 4000 life will, by default, be able to leech a maximum of 400 life from a single hit. * Added Energy Shield [[Leech]]. This is functionally similar to Life Leech, except it leeches to your Energy Shield and is limited by your maximum Energy Shield Leech Rate. Several passive skill clusters have been added to support this new form of leech. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Multiple leech effects now stack. A single hit against multiple targets grants multiple effects, as do multiple hits against a single target. * The speed at which you leech has been substantially reduced for both life and mana, with less of a reduction to mana leech rate, bringing it in-line with life leech rate. These now default to 2% of maximum life per second. It can be increased. * A maximum leech rate caps the rate at which you can leech. It's set to 20% of maximum life or mana per second. * Methods of improving leech, leech rate and increasing your maximum leech rate have been added to new clusters in the passive skill tree, primarily in the regions between the Marauder, Duelist and Ranger. * Some of the already existing clusters in this region that specialized in specific weapon types have also had leech elements added to them. * All existing values of leech have been substantially reduced, including values on existing items. * Some things such as Support Gems and Warlord's Mark have had their values brought in line with the other leech changes. * Previously, we had modifiers for "increased (or reduced) Life/Mana Leech rate". These did two things: They increased the amount of Life/Mana you're gaining per second for each leech effect and they reduced the duration of each leech effect, such that the total life/mana gained over the duration remained the same. All such modifiers have now been changed to "increased (or reduced) Life/Mana Leeched per second". This still increases the value of Life/Mana you're gaining per second for each leech effect, exactly as it did before. It no longer affects duration of the leech effects, meaning you'll gain more total life/mana from each one as a result. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.6| * Life leech now recovers the leeched life at twice the previous rate. * Mana leech now recovers the leeched mana at 25% more than the previous rate. * Reduced leech available on [[item]]s. }} {{Version history table row|0.7.0| * Changed life
